notes: 20MW colocation/HPC data centre in Launceston (potential up to 40MW); immersion liquid cooling up to 100kW/rack, PUE ~1.03, renewable-powered; grid demand-response via DRADIS. A second 20MW hall (LST02) was planned at the same campus (target mid-2022 per source); status of LST02 not re-verified (grade B, DCD).
